Hello,

We are sorry to hear that your experience at our clinic did not fully meet your expectations.

Unfortunately, a 3-star rating without any comments or details about the consultation or the reason for dissatisfaction does not allow us to understand what disappointed you and therefore cannot provide you with a precise response.

The entire clinic team is dedicated to ensuring that each patient receives attentive, professional, and respectful care, and we value our clients' feedback, whether positive or negative.

If you would like to share your experience with us and help us understand what could be improved, please contact us directly. We are always available for constructive dialogue.

Sincerely,
The Veterinary Clinic Team

In February, it will be a year since my cat, my life, my purring machine, passed away… She was treated for over three years at the clinic in L'Estaque. Only money matters at this veterinary clinic, just money, no love for the animal! I will never forget how I was treated, and even less how they treated my cat, force-feeding her medication that only hastened her illness due to incorrect dosage! Once again, it's all about money, always more money! That's called being mercenary, and they'll use any means necessary to get more money! Run away!!!!
